findings.body: The repository rules require the default build to be offline, with network access behind features. Setting `enabled = true` in the default configuration enables outbound calls to OpenRouter unless the embeddings code is explicitly gated by a Cargo feature. This could cause unexpected network traffic and potential data leakage to a third-party API when users run with default settings. Change `enabled` to `false` or ensure the functionality is behind a feature flag not enabled by default.
findings.existing_code:
[embeddings]
enabled = true
provider = "openrouter"
model = "openai/text-embedding-3-small"
dimensions = 1536
api_key_env = "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"
findings.suggestion:
[embeddings]
enabled = false
provider = "openrouter"
model = "openai/text-embedding-3-small"
dimensions = 1536
api_key_env = "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"
findings.title: Disable network-enabled embeddings by default

value.summary: The change adds an embeddings configuration that enables network retrieval through OpenRouter by default, which appears to violate the repository's offline-first rule. It should be gated behind a feature or disabled by default before merging.
